title: STD-EU-13: the standard European load on a Bosch eco programme, round robin 2022/2023, class means

provenance.source: Round robin test 2022/2023 on EN 60436:2020 in 17 laboratories, final report, Tables 36 to 45 (docs/research/standards.md section 7.1, source S11): test appliance Bosch SMV6ECX51E, eco programme, detergent D, 37 runs

round_robin.description: mean IEC cleaning score of the items of a class in one run (0 to 5), averaged over runs and laboratories; the standard deviation is over runs and laboratories

provenance.notes: A weak observation: provisional anchoring to another machine. The round robin washed 140 items in a Bosch SMV6ECX51E (eco: 270 min, main wash 53.8 to 54.3 C measured, final rinse 47.4 to 47.9 C, 9.5 L). Here the settled careful IEC load of packages/loader/loads/ (114 of the 140 items: 8 of 13 glasses, 10 of 19 tea items; whatever the loading policy did not place is missing) stands in the owner's SMV4HAX40G on its Eco 50 with the main wash limited to 54 C and the final rinse to 48 C. Soil quantities, covered areas and ageing are the working quantities of standards 13.3 (anchors/src/scenario.ts), not measured ones. The published values are class means; there are no item scores, so `observations` is empty and the class means are in `aggregates`, which the anchoring fit reads. Class means are compared after weighting the item types to the standard composition (`standard_composition`).

course.notes: targets of the test appliance as measured in the round robin (standards 3.2); step lengths are those of the owner's Eco 50
